programme.desc: The Hofstadter Insufficiency: Sheldon and Penny bond while Leonard is away. Raj finds someone to share his heartache. Bernadette and Amy attract male attention at a conference.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Deception Verification: Leonard returns early from his research expedition as a surprise for Penny, but Sheldon becomes upset that he wasn't in on the secret.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Scavenger Vortex: Raj organises an epic and demanding scavenger hunt, designed to test the friends' scientific knowledge and common sense.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The Raiders Minimization: Amy ruins one of Sheldon's favourite films by pointing out a flaw in the storyline. Raj and Stuart decide to create online dating profiles.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Gone Maggie Gone: When Marge temporarily loses her sight, Homer loses Maggie to a convent and Lisa has to go undercover as a nun to find her.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: In the Name of the Grandfather: Homer takes the family to Ireland so that Grampa can visit quaint village pub O'Flanagan's one last time.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Pray Anything: Jealous of Flanders' lifestyle, Homer starts to pray for material possessions, but things get out of hand when he asks for a bigger house and gets the church.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Barting Over: Bart moves into a downtown apartment of his own, and befriends famous skateboarder Tony Hawk (guest starring as himself). Also guest starring Blink-182.

programme.title: The Greatest Showman
programme.desc: (2017) Hugh Jackman, Zac Efron and Michelle Williams star in the Golden-Globe-winning, toe-tapping smash hit musical about the life and times of P.T. Barnum, who created the circus.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: I'm Spelling as Fast as I Can: Lisa wins a place at the Spellympics National Spelling Bee but discovers that it's not as clean-cut a competition as she thought.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: A Star Is Born Again: A famous and sultry movie star (guest star Marisa Tomei) swoops into town with eyes for none other than Ned Flanders, making him the envy of Springfield.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Mr Spritz Goes to Washington: Krusty wreaks havoc on the political system after the Simpsons help him to get elected.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Opposites A-Frack: Lisa calls on politician Maxine Lombard to stop Mr Burns' secret fracking operation but is taken aback when Lombard and Burns are attracted to each other.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Simpsorama: In a crossover episode, the Simpsons meet the Planet Express crew from Futurama, who've travelled through time to present-day Springfield to stop a catastrophe.

programme.title: Celebrity Gogglebox

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress
programme.desc: Italian Dressing. Disaster strikes when a bride's father is convinced his daughter's dress is far from what they had imagined. Luckily the designer agrees to customise the gown. S1, Ep11

programme.desc: Between a Sham-Rock and a Hard Place. A bride's mom and mother-in-law have conflicting opinions about the body art on her shoulder. Can the right dress bring this family together? S4, Ep7

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress: Atlanta
programme.desc: Power Play. Jessica may leave empty handed when her demands have the staff running in circles. Monique breaks shop rules when she hands her dress decision over to her fiancé. S4, Ep8

programme.title: Curvy Brides' Boutique

programme.title: Forensic Detectives

programme.title: Forensic Detectives

programme.title: Forensic Detectives
programme.desc: Deadly Dealings. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi, hiring someone can deflect guilt. Forensic science is changing this. S3, Ep5

programme.title: Diabolical: Deadly Love

programme.title: Diabolical: Deadly Love

programme.title: Diabolical: Deadly Love

programme.title: Diabolical: Deadly Love

programme.title: Diabolical: Deadly Love
programme.desc: Killer Track Record. When three women die of the same mysterious illness, the hunt is on to prove their deaths were no accident. Can detectives unravel this twisted tale of deceit? S3, Ep8

programme.title: Diabolical: Deadly Love

programme.title: Supercar

programme.title: Thunderbirds

programme.title: Look At Life The Village Sleeps Again

programme.title: One Step Beyond

programme.title: Sea of Sand
programme.desc: 1958. War. Guy Green. Stars Richard Attenborough, Michael Craig & John Gregson. The Long Range Desert Group go on an expedition through North Africa to destroy a huge Nazi fuel dump.

programme.title: Look At Life Trouble Shooters
programme.desc: 1964. Filmed in Sarawak, we take a look at Britain's trouble shooters - the Royal Marines.

programme.title: The One That Got Away

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: Death of a Butcher. 1961. Stars Rupert Davies, Ewen Solon & Helen Shingler. A wealthy meat trader who is also an old school friend of Maigret's, requests for police protection.

programme.title: A Family At War
programme.desc: The Lucky Ones. 1971. Created by John Finch. Stars Colin Douglas, Colin Campbell & Barbara Flynn. The iconic seventies drama series continues with the third and final series. (S3, E01)

programme.title: The Lost World
programme.desc: 2001. Adventure. Adapted by Adrian Hodges. Stars Bob Hoskins, James Fox & Elaine Cassidy. Part 1. An expedition leaves for the jungle where a man battles with dinosaurs and primitive ancestors.

programme.title: Angel
programme.desc: 1984. Thriller. Director: Robert Vincent O'Neil. Stars Cliff Gorman, Susan Tyrrell & Dick Shawn. Molly earns her living as a prostitute but a serial killer is targeting people in her profession.
